description_en: Queries scaling configurations of the Elastic Container Instance type. When you call the DescribeEciScalingConfigurations operation, you can specify ScalingGroupId, ScalingConfigurationIds, or ScalingConfigurationNames to query details about the desired scaling configurations, such as the instance bidding policy, instance type, image pulling policy, and load balancing weight of each elastic container instance. This can help you select a suitable template for creating elastic container instances or reference existing scaling configurations before you modify the automatic scaling policy for elastic container instances
description_zh: 通过调用DescribeEciScalingConfigurations，并指定伸缩组的ID、伸缩配置的ID或名称等参数查询ECI类型的伸缩配置信息，例如实例的抢占策略、容器组的实例规格、容器镜像的拉取策略、ECI实例作为后端服务器时的权重等
kebab_example: aliyun ess describe-eci-scaling-configurations --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 50 --scaling-group-id asg-bp17pelvl720x3v70000 --scaling-configuration-ids asc-bp17pelvl720x5ub0000 --scaling-configuration-names scalingcon0000 --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeEciScalingConfigurations

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group to which the scaling configuration belongs
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩配置所属伸缩组的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number. Pages start from page 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩配置列表的页码，起始值：1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值：50。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group. You can use the ID to query all scaling configurations in the scaling group
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩组的ID，您可以查询该伸缩组下所有的伸缩配置
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the scaling configurations that you want to query. You can specify 1 to 10 scaling configuration IDs.

The IDs of active and inactive scaling configurations are displayed in the query results. You can distinguish between active and inactive scaling configurations based on the value of `LifecycleState`
parameters.help_zh:
待查询伸缩配置的ID列表，ID数量取值范围：1～10。

查询结果包括生效和未生效的伸缩配置，并通过返回参数`LifecycleState`进行标识
parameters.name: scaling_configuration_ids

parameters.help_en:
The names of the scaling configurations that you want to query. You can specify 1 to 10 scaling configuration names.

The names of inactive scaling configurations are not displayed in the query results, and no error is reported
parameters.help_zh:
待查询伸缩配置的名称列表，名称数量的取值范围：1～10。

查询结果会忽略失效的伸缩配置名称，并且不报错
parameters.name: scaling_configuration_names
